name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd
title: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd - 540716 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Growth reaccelerated in H2 (GDPI +15.7%, Q4 +18.2%) but commercial lines share fell and Motor CR is elevated industry-wide; FY26 1/n combined ratio rose to 103.4% from 102.8%.

triggers.label: Competition intensified in Commercial
triggers.quote: Yes, it has intensified on Commercial Line of business.

triggers.label: Q4 GDPI growth 18.2%
triggers.quote: ICICI Lombard achieved a growth of 18.2% & 15.7% in Q4 FY2026 & H2 FY2026 respectively

triggers.label: Motor TP industry loss ratio ~85%
triggers.quote: the industry level, as far as Motor TP is concerned, is at around 85% and thereabouts, which is significantly elevated

triggers.label: Commercial share down 0.7-0.8pp
triggers.quote: This year, we have closed by 0.8%, 0.7% basis point lower.

guidance.quote: the range that we are comfortable on Motor is between 65% to 67%
We do expect a higher single-digit growth at the industry level.
It would be probably single digit.
roughly translates to almost about 25% of our profit after tax.

red_flags.label: Motor TP reserve/loss ratio scrutiny
red_flags.quote: this year's 4th Quarter Motor TP loss ratio has been significantly lower than what we have seen in the last year

red_flags.label: Crop loss ratio negative in Q4 from booking timing
red_flags.quote: we had predominantly large exposure on crop, largely from one state

evasions.topic: Motor TP loss ratio Q4 drop
evasions.quote: I think we have to keep looking at numbers more on a full year basis as compared to any given quarters.

evasions.topic: Commercial market share and FY27 growth
evasions.quote: There is so much happening all around that how do we predict that?
we will come back to all of you at an appropriate time
